purpose: Restaurants still missing publishable hours after source review

restaurants.name: Beans of Eden
restaurants.notes: Two dated snapshots of the same directory give daily 7 AM–8 PM and 8 AM–8 PM. Cannery Row confirms the address without hours. Call the listed cafe number (831) 215-6209 to confirm current opening time.

restaurants.name: Dippin' Dots
restaurants.notes: Restaurantji gives Sun–Fri noon–6 PM and Sat 11 AM–8 PM. A prior location listing gave daily 11 AM–5:30 PM, and SuperPages warns hours may vary. The destination directory confirms the location without hours. Call (831) 655-5080 for current shop hours.

restaurants.name: Great American Cookies
restaurants.notes: Roadtrippers and Restaurant Guru list daily 11 AM–8 PM, and 411.info labels its matching time range owner-verified. SuperPages lists daily 11 AM–9 PM. The Cannery Row directory confirms the storefront but gives no hours. Confirm closing time at (831) 641-9300.

restaurants.name: Paper Wing Theatre & Supper Club
restaurants.notes: The theater advertises specific shows and ticketed dining events. The Chamber's Mon–Fri 10 AM–5 PM applies to its office, and its Thu–Mon 4–10 PM listing applies to a separate sushi walk-up window. Call (831) 905-5684 for the event's meal service time or to confirm any regular dining hours.

restaurants.name: Starbucks Coffee (Lighthouse District)
restaurants.notes: Official location page yielded no readable schedule. Tripadvisor reports daily 5 AM–8 PM, Waze daily 5:30 AM–8 PM, and Yellow Pages reports 4:30 AM–9 PM Mon–Sat and 4:30 AM–8:30 PM Sun. Call (831) 656-9390 to distinguish cafe and drive-through hours.

restaurants.name: Monarch Pub & Restaurant
restaurants.notes: Chamber directory reports a Sun–Thu close of 10 AM, an apparent error, and Fri–Sat at 11 PM. Tripadvisor reports Sun–Thu 10 PM and Fri–Sat 10:30 PM; the 2026 Pacific Grove guide reports 10 PM daily. Call (831) 324-4987 for food service and pub closing times.

restaurants.name: The Perfect Crumb Bakery
restaurants.notes: Current listings at the Pacific Grove location give Sat–Mon and Wed–Thu 6:30 AM–5 PM, Fri 7 AM–5 PM, Tue closed. The official home page and Chamber confirm the move, but the official contact page still displays a temporary move closure and no weekly hours. Call (831) 241-6269 to confirm the current schedule.

restaurants.name: Domenico's Fish Market and Deli
restaurants.notes: The Wharf Association lists the market and deli separately without hours. Domenico's site explicitly gives daily 11:30 AM to close for the dining room only. Call (831) 372-3655 for separate market counter hours.

restaurants.name: Bobalicious and Bites
restaurants.notes: Current Restaurantji listing gives daily noon–8 PM, while its older snapshot gave noon–7 PM weekdays and noon–7:30 PM weekends. A merchant-authored summer promotion confirms noon–8 PM for Mondays only during the promotion. The official site has no readable weekly schedule. Call (831) 666-7030 to verify all days.

restaurants.name: Kuma Sushi
restaurants.notes: At 414 Alvarado St, the Chamber lists Tue–Thu 4:30–9 PM, Fri–Sat 4:30–9:30 PM and Sun 1–7 PM, while Tripadvisor lists daily 5–10 PM and online ordering posts a separate split schedule. Call the current number in the Old Monterey merchant directory, 831-324-4745, to confirm dine-in hours.

restaurants.name: Gelato By The Sea
restaurants.notes: The Cannery Row property directory and Monterey County Now confirm the new branch at 700 Cannery Row, Suite O. No visitor hours were found for this branch. The Carmel schedule and hiring shift hours cannot establish the Cannery Row schedule. Confirm hours directly at this storefront.

restaurants.name: Starbucks (Del Monte Center)
restaurants.notes: Call (831) 642-0736. Mall tenant page confirms this cafe and phone but publishes no weekly hours. Waze gives daily 6 AM–7 PM at 492 Del Monte Center. The existing research listing reported 5 AM–9/9:30 PM. The store locator for this cafe is 18425 and supplies no readable hours. Store 66442 is downtown.

restaurants.name: Benny Walker's
restaurants.notes: Soft-opening hours reported as daily 4–8 PM at 444 Alvarado St, with longer 11 AM–10:30 PM hours possible as soon as Nov 11. Downtown association lists the venue but no standing schedule. Confirm the post-soft-opening schedule with the operator.

restaurants.name: Compact Disco — EAT takeout window
restaurants.notes: Compact Disco’s June announcement gives a 2 AM close for the all-ages walk-up window at 420 Tyler Street on Friday and Saturday nights. Edible Monterey Bay reported 10 PM–2 AM on those nights in June. Later operator social posts describe different opening hours for the 21+ pub kitchen. The current downtown association listing confirms the window exists at 420 Tyler Street but omits hours. Confirm the current takeout window schedule separately from club, happy-hour and in-pub kitchen hours.

restaurants.name: Pretzelmaker
restaurants.notes: Call (831) 521-6001. Official tenant page confirms the location but has no weekly hours. Restaurantji and Yellow Pages list Mon–Fri 11 AM–8 PM, Sat 11 AM–7 PM, Sun 11 AM–5 PM. USA Restaurants lists Friday until 9 PM with a different phone number. Confirm the tenant’s Friday closing time and weekly schedule.

restaurants.name: Whole Foods Market — Prepared Foods
restaurants.notes: Call (831) 333-1600 for the Prepared Foods counter and hot bar. The location page confirms the hot bar but publishes only supermarket hours. Counter service may run on a different schedule.
